_verified: 2026-08-21: every entry below was replayed against localhost:3000 and the resulting state read back on screen before any capture ran. Three corrections came out of that: the Publish button opens the confirm dialog directly (there is no separate publish-open state), comment mode's only cue is the pressed toggle plus a crosshair capture layer, and the ⌘K palette cannot be captured at all — it closes when the capture script takes focus. | 2026-08-22: added BL-0213..BL-0217, the six-toggle canvas overlay states and the '?' cheat sheet — states the baseline had no board for at all, found by walking CanvasFooterToolbar. `button:text-is("Grid")` is unambiguous: the Insert drawer's own Grid row is a DIV, not a button. Two things these recipes cannot promise: a CSS-painted overlay (grid lines, badges) does not survive html-to-design, and the click leaves the pointer on the toggle so its hover tooltip lands in the frame.

_flow.method: BFS from flowStartingPoints, carriers = [frame, ...frame.findAll()] — in-degree is not reachability, and a reaction on the FRAME itself is invisible to findAll alone.

currentEra.note: The 2026-08-21 re-captures, the five canvas-overlay frames, and the four money-path captures (review, publish-open, templates, publish panel).

wired: CURRENT shell header: Site menu -> site-menu-open, Notifications -> notifications-open, Comments -> comments-mode-on, Publish -> publish-confirm; each of those returns by pressing the same control again, and publish-confirm by Cancel.
CURRENT shell footer: Grid / Rulers / Badges / X-Ray -> the four canvas-overlay frames, ? -> the cheat sheet.

Canvas content: a text element -> inspector-text, a button -> inspector-button, the row container -> inspector-container. All three return on Escape, which is what Escape does in the app (it deselects).
Site menu's Components row -> sitemenu-components; its Close -> shell.
Cmd+K on the shell -> cmdk-open; the palette's own 'Esc close' -> shell.

The superseded 2026-08-19 shell had no way out once its overlay links moved, so its rail was wired to its own five panels — it is a comparison cluster, but a flow starting point that goes nowhere is a defect in the file.

_flow.harnessNote: capture.mjs takes `sentinel` as an OBJECT — {selector} or {text}. A bare string is read as no sentinel at all and the row is refused as an unverifiable capture, which reads like a broken app rather than a malformed row.
